messages:
Alex: Quick kickoff: we need final hero lines, email sequence, and webinar RSVP flow for the upcoming inference launch. Focus: clarify which product mode is right per buyer and route inbound accordingly.
Priya: I'll own hero copy. First pass: Hosted: 'Instant API access, production latency.' Dedicated: 'Reserved capacity, steady throughput.' Private: 'Full-data control, enterprise network.' Keeping them short.
Jon: Looks good. Add supporting subheads that hint at differentiation: cost signal for Hosted, SLA for Dedicated, compliance for Private. Also add a tiny benchmark link "See latency & cost tests."
Marta: Email plan: 3 sends. 1) Launch + product primer with 3 CTAs. 2) Benchmark highlights + download. 3) Webinar invite + registration. Need UTM and routing rules: Hosted->signup, Dedicated/Private->sales form.
Alex: Yes, Hosted must be self-serve. Dedicated/Private route to sales. Add hidden param cohort=launch-april so we can filter.
Marta: Proposed URLs: Hosted -> /signup?utm_campaign=launch_april&cohort=launch-april Dedicated -> /contact-sales?utm_campaign=launch_april&cohort=launch-april&interest=dedicated Private -> /contact-sales?utm_campaign=launch_april&cohort=launch-april&interest=private
Priya: CTA microcopy options: Hosted: 'Start free' / 'Try hosted' Dedicated: 'Request capacity' Private: 'Book private review' Which tone do we want? Direct action.
Jon: Use 'Start free' for Hosted. For the benchmark blurb in email 2, keep it story-led: "Real apps: chat and embeddings. See how caching and batching cut token cost." Legal to review any numeric claims.
marketing-bot: :robot_face: Checklist saved: hero drafts (Priya), email sequence + links (Marta), benchmark note (Jon).
Alex: Webinar format: 40 minutes (20 demo, 15 Q&A, 5 CTA). RSVP should capture product interest via radio (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). RSVP picks must tag lead in HubSpot.
Marta: On the RSVP flow: I'll add a hidden field mode_interest and append ?mode=hosted|dedicated|private to confirmation page so follow-up emails personalize. Also will ensure HubSpot mapping for that field.
Priya: A/B subject line ideas for email 1: A) 'New: Production inference, your way' B) 'Host or reserve inference for your product' Preview text: 'Benchmarks, demo, and migration playbook.'
Jon: For the landing pages, don't show raw p95s in hero. Use a micro-note: 'Benchmarked under real workloads  see methodology.' Link to a dedicated benchmark page with tables.
Marta: Engineers: simple redirect snippet for marketing clicks so we keep UTM consistency.
Marta: ```
# simple redirect pseudo
def redirect_for_mode(mode):
  if mode == 'hosted':
    return '/signup?utm_campaign=launch_april&cohort=launch-april'
  if mode == 'dedicated':
    return '/contact-sales?utm_campaign=launch_april&cohort=launch-april&interest=dedicated'
  if mode == 'private':
    return '/contact-sales?utm_campaign=launch_april&cohort=launch-april&interest=private'
```
Priya: I'll produce 3 hero PNG comps and 3 button labels by EOD Wednesday and upload to the drive.
Marta: I'll draft the three emails and the RSVP form by Thursday morning, plus HubSpot field mapping.
Jon: I'll prepare the benchmark one-pager and note any claims requiring legal signoff by Thursday EOD.
Alex: Great. Final ask: make sure the webinar registration confirmation email includes the one-pager download link and mode-specific next steps. Ping here when everything is in drive. :rocket:
